# watchpoint_status_page (Resource)

A public status page for a tenant. Components, subscribers, and rendering are managed outside this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_status_page" "example" {
  slug             = "api"
  tenant_slug      = "acme"
  name             = "API Status"
  description      = "Uptime for our public REST API"
  is_enabled       = true
  default_language = "en"
}

# An internal page only staff can open, gated on their email domain.
resource "watchpoint_status_page" "internal" {
  slug                  = "internal"
  tenant_slug           = "acme"
  name                  = "Internal Services"
  visibility            = "EmailDomainRestricted"
  allowed_email_domains = ["acme.com", "acme-contractors.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable status page name.
- `slug` (String) Per-tenant unique slug (3-63 lowercase alphanumerics / hyphens).
- `tenant_slug` (String) Denormalized tenant slug used by the public host resolver (3-63 lowercase alphanumerics / hyphens).

### Optional

- `accent_color` (String) Branding: 6- or 8-digit hex accent color (e.g. `#3B82F6`).
- `access_password` (String, Sensitive) Shared password visitors must enter when `visibility` is `PasswordProtected`. Write-only: the API stores only a hash and never returns it, so a password changed outside Terraform is not detected. Removing it from configuration clears the stored password.
- `allowed_email_domains` (Set of String) Email domains whose owners may view the page when `visibility` is `EmailDomainRestricted`, for example `acme.com`. Unordered. Values are stored lower-cased with any leading `@` stripped.
- `custom_css` (String) Custom stylesheet for the public page (20000 characters max). The API sanitizes it and scopes every rule under the page root: `@import`, remote `url()`, `expression()` and similar are stripped. The configured text is kept in state, so sanitization does not show as drift. Requires the `status_custom_css` feature (Scale); removing it is always allowed.
- `default_language` (String) Language the public viewer renders in for every visitor: `en`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pt-BR`, `ja`, `nl`. Omit to follow the visitor's browser.
- `description` (String) Optional page description.
- `enabled_languages` (Set of String) Languages the public viewer offers in its language picker. Must include `default_language` when that is set. Omit to keep what the page has; reads return every language when none are restricted. Restricting requires the status page localization feature.
- `favicon_url` (String) Branding: favicon URL.
- `footer_html` (String) Branding: HTML footer (sanitized server-side to a strict tag/attribute whitelist).
- `footer_text` (String) Branding: plain-text footer.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the page is published. Defaults to the server default on create.
- `logo_url` (String) Branding: logo URL.
- `primary_dashboard_id` (String) Optional dashboard whose components seed the page.
- `tenant_name` (String) Optional denormalized tenant display name.
- `visibility` (String) Audience gate on the page: `Public`, `PasswordProtected`, `EmailDomainRestricted`. Defaults to `Public`. Switching to `PasswordProtected` requires `access_password` and switching to `EmailDomainRestricted` requires `allowed_email_domains`, in the same apply.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `has_access_password` (Boolean) Whether an access password is currently stored. The password itself is never readable.
- `id` (String) Status page ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-updated timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_status_page.example page_001
```
